# Third-party and generated files

Fork-local file of cogniumhq/idempiere (Cognium's fork of iDempiere core); it is not part of any upstream contribution.

This list names the paths in this repository that iDempiere did not write by hand. The machine-readable copy is [`.loop/third-party.json`](.loop/third-party.json); the root [`.gitattributes`](.gitattributes) marks the same paths `linguist-vendored` (generated paths also `linguist-generated`). The three must list the same paths: change them together.

## What is listed

- **Upstream iDempiere's own code is not listed.** It is the subject of this fork: we change it and send the changes upstream.
- **Vendored:** libraries and assets upstream ships in the tree (JavaScript, CSS, fonts, schemas), source copied from other projects that keeps its own copyright header or package and authors, third-party binaries and build scripts. Evidence for each entry is its `reason` (a banner, a licence header, a package name with its authors, a README step).
- **Generated:** tool output that is regenerated, never edited: the `X_` and `I_` model classes (from the Application Dictionary, which only the developer changes: AGENTS.md rule 3), the ANTLR parser of `SimpleBoolean.g4`, and a 2005 javadoc. These are iDempiere's, listed so that nothing patches them by hand; a fix goes to their source.
- **Not in the tree, so not listed:** the jars. Third-party Java libraries come in at build time from the Tycho target platform (`org.idempiere.p2.targetplatform/*.target`) and the poms; they are dependencies, not vendored paths. No `.jar` is committed (`lib/` holds only `generatep2.txt`).

## Policy (the default for every entry)

`{"test": false, "fix": false, "report": "opt-in"}`

- **Not tested or checked** by the Loop; a finding in one of these paths does not count against the repository.
- **Not fixed:** the Loop and its agents do not change these paths, and a patch that edits one is refused. A vendored file is replaced from its source; a generated file is regenerated from its source.
- **Reported only on request:** the owner can opt in to have findings listed, apart and never auto-fixed.

## Not third-party (checked)

- iDempiere's own files kept in another project's package for package access, each with iDempiere's header: `fi/jawsy/jawwa/zk/atmosphere/Either.java`, the `package-info.java` files of `org.zkoss.addon.chosenbox` and `org.zkforge.keylistener`, `org.idempiere.zk.extra/src/org/zkoss/zul/impl/CustomGridDataLoader.java`, and `FilterChainImpl`, `FilterRegistration`, `HttpServiceProxy`, `HttpServiceProxyFactory` in the Equinox bridge bundle.
- Code adapted by iDempiere under its own header: `org/adempiere/webui/util/Statistic.java` (adapted from ZK's `Statistic`).
- iDempiere's wrappers around vendored libraries: the `zk.wpd` package files beside html2canvas-pro, the masked input plugin and Photobooth; `Billboard.js`, `mold/billboard.js` and the `billboard.<type>.js` renderers; `datatables/customization.css`; `org/idempiere/commons/*.js`, `websocket/serverpush.js`, `adempiere/local/storage/token.js`; the CKEditor configs in `org.adempiere.ui.zk/js/ckeditor/`.
- `org.adempiere.ui.zk/css/font-awesome.css.dsp`: iDempiere's 37-line ZK template of `@font-face` rules with Font Awesome's banner; the fonts themselves come from the ZK jar, not this repository.
- Configuration the product deploys and owns, though derived from a vendor's sample: `org.adempiere.ui.zk/WEB-INF/zk.xml` (Potix copyright line), `org.adempiere.server-feature/hazelcast-template.xml` (Hazelcast's default configuration with iDempiere's install placeholders), `org.adempiere.server-feature/jettyhome/etc/*.xml`, `.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties`. Hardening them is the product's own work.
- The two themes `org.idempiere.zk.breeze.theme` and `org.idempiere.zk.iceblue_c.theme` (iDempiere's themes, based on ZK's), the OSGi component XML under `OSGI-INF/` (produced by `generate-ds.sh` from the Java's `@Component` annotations, so it changes together with that Java, which the Loop may change), the licence texts of iDempiere itself (`LICENSE.md`, `license.html` files), the Compiere, ADempiere and contributor code (`org.compiere`, `org.adempiere`, `org.eevolution`, `org.globalqss`, …) apart from the generated model classes listed above, `db/`, `migration/` and `migration-historic/`.
- The sponsor logos in `org.adempiere.ui.zk/html/Credits_files/` are their owners' marks shown on the Credits page: content, not code.

## Updating

1. Replace a vendored file from its upstream release (keep its banner), or regenerate a generated one from its source.
2. Update its entry in `.loop/third-party.json` (version, licence, `modified_locally`, notes) and its row here.
3. A new vendored or generated path gets an entry, a row and a `.gitattributes` line in the same change. Only the owner changes this marking; the Loop refuses a patch that edits it.
